classification.difficultyReason: Constructs two qualitative graphs from unscaled component graphs and their limiting behaviour.

inlines.text: on a separate set of axes.

answer.short:
The two sketches are shown. Both have $y$-intercept $f(0)$. The sum approaches $g$ from above to the right; the difference approaches $-g$ from above to the right.

Add ordinates for the sum and subtract the ordinate of $g$ for the difference.
answer.worked:
At each $x$, add the ordinates for $f+g$ and subtract the ordinate of $g$ from that of $f$ for $f-g$. Since $g(0)=0$, both graphs pass through $(0,f(0))$.

To the right, $f$ approaches zero, so the sum approaches $g$ from above and the difference approaches $-g$ from above. To the left, $f$ approaches its positive horizontal asymptote, so each result approaches the corresponding straight line shifted upwards by that limiting height. Join the ordinate points smoothly as shown.
